concern.concern: The Definition instructs one to glue x and y from two ordinary complex skein modules, sets B_Σ(x,y)=Z_p(S³,Γ,w), and then declares this conjugate-linear in y. Ordinary gluing and evaluation are complex-linear in both skein inputs: for empty skeins in complementary balls, the displayed construction gives B(∅,i∅)=iη, whereas the declared sesquilinearity requires −iη, with η≠0. An explicit semilinear orientation-reversal/conjugation map on the second input is missing. BHMV Proposition 1.9, p.891, uses M glued to −M′ and reverses the second link; §5.8, pp.912–913, expressly distinguishes this sesquilinear pairing from the complementary bilinear pairing. Clarify the actual domains and reversal before using the coefficient-conjugate space and inverse tensor in the pairing lemma.
